content_of_post_to_answer: Why do you think so many people have lost the ability to enjoy just sitting still in nature?
answer: I suspect we've gradually trained ourselves to expect every idle moment to provide some kind of stimulation. Sitting in nature offers no notifications, novelty on demand, or immediate reward. At first, that quiet can feel uncomfortable because the mind has nowhere to escape its unfinished thoughts. But there's a difference between being bored and being unoccupied. We've become so accustomed to filling empty moments that we've forgotten how much can be experienced when nothing demands our attention.
